context: A chef and barista plan a menu
purpose: Teach: 大将/造っ/初戦/日立/造形/フラワー/チューブ/ムリ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、ぼく、和食の大将って、呼ばれるの、まんざらでもないんやで。
lines.en: Aoi, I have to tell you—I don't mind being called the washoku master one bit.
lines.style: Warm and proud, Kansai lilt softening the boast. Leaning in like sharing a secret. Slight lift at the end, inviting her into the joke.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。新店舗、内装、こだわって、造ってまいります。
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure the new location has a really thoughtful interior design.
lines.style: Bright and assured, matching his energy. Clipped, professional—the words of someone who's already thought this through. Nodding forward slightly.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: チェーン展開、初戦は、地元の駅前店、勝負やで、葵さん。
lines.en: This first location near the station—that's our real proving ground, Aoi. Make or break.
lines.style: Animated, energized. Kansai emphasis on 「勝負」—the stakes landing clear. Leaning forward like he's placing a bet. Conviction underneath the lightness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。日立のオーブン、新規導入、検討しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're looking into bringing in a new Hitachi oven—studying the specs now.
lines.style: Measured and practical. Each detail delivered like a checkbox. Not rushed, but efficient. The tone of someone managing a to-do list with care.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 料理は造形美も、大事やで、見た目、命やからな。
lines.en: Cooking is visual art too—what it looks like is everything. That's the heart of it.
lines.style: Earnest now, the levity dropping. Deliberate pace. Touching his chest lightly as he says 「命」. Speaking like someone who believes this down to his bones.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。フラワーアーティスト、お招きするイベント、企画しませんか。
lines.en: What if we brought in a floral artist? We could do an event together—plan something really special.
lines.style: Soft and collaborative, not tentative. Offering an idea like a gift. Warm eye contact. Slightly higher pitch on the question, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 絵の具のチューブみたいに、ソース、絞り出すの、新しい技法、試そうか。
lines.en: Picture this—squeeze sauce out of a tube like paint, like it's a whole new technique we're pioneering.
lines.style: Animated and playful, momentum returning. Almost bouncing with the idea. Miming the squeeze with his hand. Energy building—excited, not silly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。スタッフ、ムリせず、休めるような体制、整えていきたいですね。
lines.en: Yes. And I want to build a schedule where the staff can actually rest—where nobody burns out.
lines.style: Warm but grounded. The levity settling into something genuine. Held with quiet firmness. Like she's drawing a line she won't cross, and inviting him to stand with her.
